name: Valorian Online
storyline:
Before time and space, the end of a previous creation gave rise to Unos, the first being. Consumed by solitude, Unos sacrificed his own existence to bring forth a new universe. From his divine essence emerged six sparks, five of which awakened as the Primeval Gods, responsible for shaping the world of Valorian and the forces that govern it.

Zalthor created the world, while he and his twin brother Thyros brought humanity and animals into existence. Vazrath established the invisible laws of the cosmos, Azaryel populated the hidden corners of the world with monsters and supernatural beings, and Yero became the ancestral guardian of mortals and the keeper of humanity's fate. For ages, the five gods existed in harmony, maintaining the balance of creation. Yet the sixth divine spark remained dormant, its location and potential still unknown.
summary:
Valorian Online is a free-to-play 2D isometric fantasy MMORPG featuring pixel art graphics, character progression, exploration, and real-time combat.

Players explore a fantasy world inhabited by mythical creatures and shaped by ancient gods and powerful factions. The game features distinct character classes and subclasses, equipment progression, customizable abilities, quests, and a variety of creatures to encounter throughout the adventure.
